sections.title: Anatomy of a Bulb
points: Filament: Made of Tungsten (Wolfram). Has high resistance and a high melting point.
Inert Gases: Argon/Nitrogen prevent the filament from oxidizing (burning up).
Transformation: Electrical energy → Heat energy → Light energy.

sections.title: The Torch Parts
points: Reflector: Focuses light into a parallel/diverging beam.
Tail Spring: Completes the circuit to the casing and holds batteries tight.
Casing: If rusted, it acts as an insulator and the torch fails.

cards.fact: Filament is broken, creating an open circuit.
